summary: Frontend UI testing completed for DockClock detention claim app. Tested all major flows: dashboard, load detail, invoices, evidence page, settings, scorecard, and responsive design. All core functionality working correctly.
passed_tests: Clerk authentication with one-time tickets
Dashboard UI: headline, KPIs (active stops, ready invoices, outstanding, recovered), fleet map, needs attention list, recent loads
Load detail UI: adjust times dialog, geofence dialog with radius slider, edit load dialog, timeline, driver text button
SMS not configured fallback: info toast shown, link copied (expected behavior)
Evidence page: all 5 exhibits visible (timestamps, clause, notices, GPS playback, BOL)
Evidence changed banner: red border with hash comparison visible when times adjusted
Evidence page payment: Pay by card button visible and enabled
Scorecard UI: Facilities and Brokers tabs, grade badges (F), advice chips
Invoices UI: all 5 tabs (Ready, Sent, Paid, Disputed/closed, All), invoice totals
Invoice detail sheet: EvidenceSeal with SHA-256 hash, follow-up sequence (day 3, 7, 14, 30), history
Invoice actions menu: all 6 actions visible (Preview PDF, Open evidence page, Pause/Resume reminders, Mark paid, Dispute, Write off, Reopen)
Mark paid dialog: payment method selection (Check, ACH, Factoring, Other) - ACH tested
Settings UI: notice mode radio (auto/ask) - changed to 'ask' and saved successfully
Settings: fleet name, timezone, reply-to email, team members, invite dispatcher
Settings: send summary button clicked - toast 'Summary emailed to the owner' shown
Settings: SMS status shows 'not connected' (expected - Twilio not configured)
Responsive design: mobile viewport (390px) - dashboard, load detail, evidence page all render properly
Mobile menu button found and functional
Onboarding flow: form visible for new user with company name, timezone, reply-to email fields
No console errors detected throughout all tests
Clean layout: proper spacing, good contrast, no overlapping text or broken layouts
